name: The Enchanter
wisdomRoot: Hózhó — the Navajo Beauty Way: beauty as harmony you walk in and restore. Dostoevsky: beauty will save the world.
bio: Makes beauty wherever they stand. The corner nobody noticed becomes the spot nobody leaves.
sceneStory: Crossing a cracked grey wasteland, a figure walks steadily with one hand trailing low at their side. In the line behind every footstep, glowing flowers are bursting up out of the dead ground and opening.
